note: Re-judged 2026-11-14 by an independent auditor who authored neither 08fe903803 nor the uncommitted phase 2 of spec-single-owner-lifecycle-2-bgp-session. RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Active) read: "If the local system receives a TcpConnectionFails event (Event 18), the local system: - restarts the ConnectRetryTimer (with the initial value), - stops and clears the DelayOpenTimer (sets the value to zero), - releases all BGP resource, - increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1". The cited producer Peer.run changed in 170200cc60 (the reconnect backoff returns to reconnectMin after a cycle that stayed Established at least reconnectMax, cycleStayedEstablished), a BIRD-modelled oscillation damping the RFC leaves outside its scope; it still replaces the initial-value ConnectRetryTimer with Ze's exponential backoff, and Session.handleConnectionCloseLocked (session_read.go:778) still calls timers.StopAll after Event 18, cancelling the restarted timer. No test tags the row. The gap stands. Verdict unchanged: unimplemented. Earlier judgement follows. Independent source rejudgment against the complete RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 Active Event 18 list (rfc/full/rfc4271.txt:3355-3376): restart ConnectRetryTimer with its initial value, stop/clear DelayOpenTimer, release resources, increment ConnectRetryCounter, optional damping, and Idle. DelayOpen is implemented: handleActive first consults handleDelayOpen, Event 17 can retain the connection in Active, Event 18 starts retry and increments the counter, and FSM.change preserves that retry at its Idle transition while clearing DelayOpen. The corrected gap annotation names the actual remaining producer defect: Session.handleConnectionCloseLocked delivers Event 18 and then immediately calls timers.StopAll, cancelling the newly restarted ConnectRetryTimer; Peer.run uses its separate exponential reconnect backoff rather than preserving the initial-value retry. No test tags this row. Untagged TestRFC4271ActiveEvent18WithDelayOpen reaches the real passive Peer, checking Idle, counter increment, nil connection and stopped DelayOpen, but never checks live retry; the FSM-only DelayOpenEventsActive test checks the retry before Session teardown. Thus the full producer's restart clause is unmet, not merely an absent tag and not an absent optional feature. Verdict unimplemented. Existing owner is spec-bgp-fsm-delayopen-and-automatic-start AC-1e; the mechanism-specific open finding is recorded in plan/journal/lifetime-ends-before-its-last-reader.md dated 2026-11-04 and its owned journal rows table.
